summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload in a commitlint config package
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (identifier shapes like `_0x488df8`, nested indirection tables) and, at install time, builds a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, downloads the Bun runtime, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the downloaded `bun` binary against a package-local file `math_init.js`. If `bun` is already available on PATH the download step is skipped and the payload is executed directly. `math_init.js` is a single ~710KB obfuscated blob using javascript-obfuscator-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());... }`) so its behavior is not reviewable as source. The package's stated purpose is a commitlint configuration, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a large opaque payload executed under it. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper, obfuscated install-time script, and obfuscated sibling payload executed on `npm install` matches the install-time RCE pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
